scope: Supplied production dump restored on network-none local PostgreSQL 17.11; no app or provider calls
postgresVersion: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 15.2.0, 64-bit
network: none; Unix socket only; own port 57832; no host ports or mounts
providerSchemaScaffold: Auth/storage/extensions/vault schema-only copied from previously initialized local Supabase PostgreSQL 17.11; public application schema comes only from supplied dump
lockMethod: Migration SQL wrapped in a transaction, matching per-file push scope. pg_locks captured immediately before COMMIT. Schema rollback uses its original transaction. Relation names resolved before/after drops. Catalog reads used by the observer are excluded below; non-relation locks remain in the private receipt. Separate wait sampler runs every 30ms plus docker/query overhead; short waits can be missed. Durations include docker/psql startup and lock-receipt overhead. No competing workload.
